rules.title: rustfmt and clippy
rules.text: Run cargo fmt and cargo clippy with warnings denied.

rules.title: Result over panic
rules.text: Return Result and propagate with ?; avoid unwrap and expect outside tests.

rules.title: thiserror and anyhow
rules.text: Use thiserror for library errors and anyhow for application errors.

rules.title: Borrow before cloning
rules.text: Prefer borrowing over cloning; clone only when ownership is needed.

rules.title: Justify unsafe
rules.text: Avoid unsafe; when required, keep it minimal and document its safety invariants.
